config_name: Dell 16 Premium — Core Ultra 9 285H, 32GB LPDDR5X, 1TB SSD, 16.3" 4K OLED touch 120Hz (clearance)

specs.cpu: Intel Core Ultra 9 285H (Arrow Lake-H, 16-core, up to 5.4 GHz)
specs.gpu: Intel Arc 140T integrated (RTX 5050/5060/5070 options on higher trims)

battery.notes: 69.5Wh. 4K OLED is the thirstiest panel in the line; CNET found battery unimpressive across the Premium family (~6-8h mixed).

price.notes: dell.ca marks DA16250 'no longer available' (page redirects to 2026 XPS 16); CNET tested at US$2,860. Remaining CA retail clearance est. CAD ~$2,900 vs ~$4,200 original. VERIFY stock before relying on this entry.

reviews.quote: (score + key findings verified via handoff NOTES: 16.3" 4K OLED, RTX 5070 option throttled; exact quote text not re-fetched — slug 404s)

praises: 16.3" 4K OLED 120Hz touch at clearance pricing is the cheapest way into a 4K OLED laptop in Canada
RTX 5050/5060/5070 dGPU trims exist in clearance stock — real CUDA for creators under $3,500
Quad speakers + haptic touchpad + 8MP IR cam: AV kit the 2026 XPS line walked back
Ultra 9 285H sustains strong multicore thanks to the thicker, heavier chassis
CNET 7.9/10 called it the stronger half of the 2025 Premium pair
complaints: RTX 5070 option is power-throttled (CNET) — dGPU buyers don't get full chip performance
~2.1 kg and thick — not a true ultrabook by 2026 standards
4K OLED drains the 69.5Wh battery to ~6-8h real-world
Discontinued: no dell.ca restock, warranty/repair parts horizon shortens
Soldered RAM; glossy 4K panel mirrors bright rooms

design_philosophy: The larger sibling of the short-lived 'Dell Premium' generation: spec-max 16.3-inch with 4K OLED and throttled-but-present RTX dGPU options. Now a clearance line, it is today's value path to OLED + dGPU in Dell's premium clamshell family, at the cost of weight and battery.
rating_notes: Anchored on CNET Dell 16 Premium (2025) 7.9/10 (US$2,860, NOTES-verified; 16.3" 4K OLED, throttled RTX 5070 option). Integrated-GPU base trim assumed → gaming 5.0 (Arc 140T ~4.5 + panel/CPU headroom); dGPU trims would add +2 gaming. Battery 5.5 (4K OLED, CNET family criticism). Price estimated — clearance stock only.
